**Risk flags:**
- Revenue fell 20.7% from 2023 to 2024.  
- Director 1 holds 100.0% of shares.

**Overview:**  
Teguh Cahaya Medical Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited company operating in the healthcare sector, providing community pharmacy services and dietary supplements from its Kuala Lumpur base. It was incorporated on 9 April 1991 and has a paid‑up share capital of RM 5,000,000. Ownership is fully concentrated, with the top shareholder (Director 1) holding 100 % of the equity.
